outcome: Antenatal hospital consultations (for reduced foetal movement, other pregnancy-related concerns)
Postpartum hospital stay duration (>=4 days or discharge within 2 days)
cohort: Newly arrived migrant women in Norway, comprising those who received multicultural doula support (cases) and those who did not (controls).
finding: Multicultural doula support was associated with increased antenatal hospital consultations and timely labour admission, alongside reduced unplanned out-of-hospital births, ambulance use, and shorter postpartum hospital stays among migrant women.
